name: Docket
author: Jeremy Longshore
description: The GitHub pull requests that are waiting on you, as a queue you drain rather than a feed you scroll. Oldest obligation first, with a review clock that marks anything you are late on, and a dismissal that expires the moment the pull request changes.

barWidget.description: One GitHub GraphQL call every 15 minutes answers one question: what is waiting on me. Three lanes, oldest first, overdue marked. The pill collapses to nothing when the docket is clear. Connect with docket-login; the widget never puts your token in a process argument.

schema.label: Desktop notifications
schema.description: Notify when a pull request newly lands on your docket. Never on the first run, never on an error, never on something you already dismissed.

schema.label: Review clock (hours)
schema.description: How long a pull request may sit on your docket before it counts as overdue. Overdue rows carry a marker and turn the pill to the bar alert color.

schema.label: Bot-authored pull requests
schema.description: Dependency bots open more review requests than people do and never age out. Hidden by default so the queue reflects human obligation.

schema.label: Your own drafts
schema.description: A draft is waiting on you by definition, so showing them drowns the real signal. Hidden by default.
